grades.quote: If the rounded result is not representable in the destination format, it is clipped to the nearest value and the invalid flag is set.
grades.reason: Describes FCVT.W.S and states that when the rounded result is not representable in the destination integer format, the result is clipped to the nearest value and the invalid flag is set. The Table 28 cells are garbled, so the exact limit values are missing, but the core answer on result and flag is present.

The passage is an RVWMO register-dependency table for the RV64F conversions FCVT.L.S, FCVT.LU.S, FCVT.S.L and FCVT.S.LU. It doesn't cover FCVT.W.S. It also doesn't say what result an out-of-range input produces or which flags are raised. It only lists NV and NX as accumulating CSRs for other instructions.
Synopsis of the BF16-to-FP32 conversion. It says nothing about FCVT.W.S or out-of-range float-to-integer behavior.
Generic BF16 exception-handling text. It does not address FCVT.W.S results or flags for out-of-range inputs.
